aboutGame.title: What is Resident Evil 0?
paragraphs: Resident Evil 0 is a survival horror game from Capcom and a prequel to the original Resident Evil. Set in 1998, it follows S.T.A.R.S. medic Rebecca Chambers and escaped convict Billy Coen as they uncover the truth behind the Umbrella Corporation's experiments.

The HD Remaster modernizes the classic experience with updated visuals, widescreen support, and additional content such as Wesker Mode. Our wiki covers every area, puzzle, weapon, and boss with detailed guides and reference tables.

modules.description: An accessible starting guide covering partner zapping, the no-item-box inventory, herb mixing, combat basics, saving, and survival tips.

highlights.detail: Swap control between Rebecca and Billy with the partner zapping button
Drop items anywhere and remember each stash, because Resident Evil 0 has no item boxes
Let Rebecca mix herbs and handle puzzle items while Billy moves heavy objects
Conserve handgun ammo and pick fights you can win on the Ecliptic Express
Save at typewriters with ink ribbons, since the game has no autosaves
Keep two inventory slots free for puzzle items that appear without warning

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Resident Evil 0.

items.question: What is Resident Evil 0?
items.answer: Resident Evil 0 is a survival horror prequel from Capcom. Set in July 1998, it follows Rebecca Chambers and Billy Coen as they investigate the Umbrella Corporation's experiments aboard the Ecliptic Express and beyond.

items.question: Which platforms is Resident Evil 0 on?
items.answer: Resident Evil 0 HD Remaster is available on PC via Steam, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.

items.question: Who are the playable characters in Resident Evil 0?
items.answer: You alternate between Rebecca Chambers, a S.T.A.R.S. medic, and Billy Coen, an escaped convict. Partner zapping and character switching are central to Resident Evil 0.

items.question: Does Resident Evil 0 have item boxes?
items.answer: No. Resident Evil 0 removes item boxes entirely, so anything you drop stays in that room for the rest of the campaign and must be picked up by hand.

items.question: Is there a Wesker Mode in Resident Evil 0?
items.answer: Yes. The Resident Evil 0 HD Remaster includes Wesker Mode, which lets you replay the campaign with Albert Wesker's dash and Gaze of Destruction abilities.

items.question: Do I need to play other Resident Evil games before Resident Evil 0?
items.answer: No. Resident Evil 0 is a prequel set before the first game, so it is a fine starting point, though returning fans will recognize many characters and locations.
